verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents Wrangler as the official command line tool for building Cloudflare Workers, with commands for creating, developing, and deploying Workers. The docs also show it managing related resources (`npx wrangler d1 create`) and rollbacks, and the probe confirms the CLI documentation page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, and documented agent-oriented CLI features such as machine-readable output or non-interactive auth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: A command line tool for building [Cloudflare Workers](https://workers.cloudflare.com/).
The core Wrangler commands for creating, developing, and deploying Workers are on the Workers commands page.
You can roll back to a previously deployed version of your Worker using Wrangler or the Cloudflare dashboard.
